title: Crossmodal-3600: A Massively Multilingual Multimodal Evaluation Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a massively multilingual evaluation dataset with human-generated native captions in 36 languages to prevent English-language bias and translation artifacts (translationese), and evaluating captioning models across these languages using both automatic metrics (CIDEr) and side-by-side human evaluations.

Sampling an evaluation set of geographically diverse images using GPS coordinates associated with the regions where the 36 targeted languages are spoken, ensuring models are tested on visually and culturally diverse scenes rather than predominantly Western or Eurocentric locales.
